title: Pendentes: o prazo no canto, um pedaço por vez, um arrasto só

screens.title: 1 · Pendentes
screens.why: The deadline where a task's hour is, −1d +1d, and urgent means past its day.

pins.label: Prazo no canto
pins.text: Where a task with an hour shows its hour: hoje; the weekday in full this week (quinta-feira); 12/nov in another week; para ontem once past, in the danger ink.

pins.label: Urgente = passou do dia
pins.text: Past its day: urgentFill, 'Urgente ·' before the time done, and the red runs the whole bar with the green still over it. Behind pace alone no longer tints the card.

pins.label: −1d +1d ✓
pins.text: On every pending card, replacing −10 +10: they move the deadline a day (shiftDeadline). −1d is faded with no deadline. Agora keeps −10 +10.

pins.label: Soma das tarefas
pins.text: The whole is the larger of the task's own time (5h) and its tasks' together (6h15). Green: the minutes of tasks done over that whole. Red: working time gone, unchanged.

pins.label: Play pergunta > 1h
pins.text: Play begins at once when what would begin is an hour or less; over that, the sheet of screens 2–3.

screens.title: 2 · Play sem subtarefas
screens.why: 2h30 owed: how much now? A piece becomes a subtask of its own.

pins.label: 30 min em destaque
pins.text: The pieces: 30 min (accent, the sheet exists to take a piece) and 1h. A piece writes a task of that length into it, titled with its name, and begins it: on Agora and inside the task.

pins.label: Tudo · 2h30
pins.text: The whole of what it owes, no new subtask.

pins.label: Falar com a Lunna
pins.text: Text only, as every button of the sheet: opens the conversation with this task as its 'about'.

screens.title: 3 · Play com subtarefas
screens.why: The next subtask is 1h30: confirm it.

pins.label: Nomeia a próxima
pins.text: The next subtask (the queue's first, else the backlog's), its parent and length. Asked only when it is over an hour.

pins.label: Começar
pins.text: Text only, accent: begins that subtask (ArtifactPlayed), as today.

pins.label: Ou conversar
pins.text: Falar com a Lunna, as on screen 2. Cancelar closes.

screens.title: 4 · Arrastar para Agora
screens.why: Agora, Em seguida, Pendentes and Para depois are one drag.

pins.label: Solte para começar
pins.text: Only Agora draws itself as a target: the running card fades under an accent outline. Letting go here is play (and screens 2–3 may ask).

pins.label: Cartão carregado
pins.text: Long-press any task card (not an event) to carry it; it leaves a gap where it was (Mapa astral left Pendentes).

pins.label: Entre seções, sem pergunta
pins.text: Out of Agora to any section never asks: into Pendentes pauses it, into Para depois sends it to the backlog, into Em seguida queues it next.

screens.title: 5 · Agora ocupado
screens.why: Let go on Agora (or play) while something runs: what of it?

pins.label: O que fazer com ela?
pins.text: The same GuardSheet, on Plano and the calendar; its three answers are text only. On a vacant Agora nothing asks: it just begins.

pins.label: Concluir
pins.text: Finishes the running one, which gives its hour away (solve_current).

pins.label: Pausar em Pendentes
pins.text: New pause_current: it stops owing what it had left and stays begun, so it waits in Pendentes.

pins.label: Para depois
pins.text: New later_current: back to the backlog. 'Deixar para depois' (next in the queue) goes.
